title: Season 1: Things You Can't Live Without
summary: Explore the hidden stories behind the materials that shape our world with Rio Tinto's podcast 'Things You Can't Live Without'. Hosted by Dr Anna Ploszajski, each episode features engaging conversations with renowned guests, scientists, and industry experts.
body_markdown:
We use them every day - our phones, our cars, our cookware - but have you ever stopped to wonder how they came to be? *Things You Can't Live Without* is a podcast that explores the hidden stories behind the materials that shape our world.


Hosted by material scientist Dr Anna Ploszajski, each episode features engaging conversations with renowned guests, scientists, and industry experts to uncover how these essential objects are made, their impact on our planet, and what the future holds for producing these items.
